# Sinqobile Construction

> NHBRC-registered construction company in Johannesburg, Gauteng. Specialists in residential building, renovations, plastering, paving, tiling, plumbing, roofing, and home extensions across the Greater Johannesburg, Sandton, Pretoria, and Centurion metropolitan area. Founded 2010 by Dingwayo Reason Ndlovu. 15+ years experience. 500+ completed projects. 4.9★ rated (127 verified reviews).

## Construction Cost Reference (2026 ZAR)

### Build cost per square metre in Johannesburg
- Standard build: **R10,000 – R14,000/m²**
- Mid-range build: **R14,000 – R18,000/m²**
- Luxury build: **R18,000 – R25,000+/m²**

### Total build cost (typical homes)
- 120m² standard home: **R1.2M – R1.68M**
- 150m² mid-range home: **R2.1M – R2.7M**
- 200m² luxury home: **R3.6M – R5M+**

### Component costs
- Raft foundation: R1,200 – R2,000 per m²
- Stock brickwork: R150 – R220 per m²
- IBR steel roofing: R450 – R650 per m²
- Concrete roof tiles: R500 – R800 per m²
- Plastering: R100 – R180 per m²
- Standard tiling: R250 – R500 per m²
- Brick paving: R280 – R550 per m²
- Interior painting: R30 – R60 per m²
